Axiom: After all reopens are prepared, dispatch the reopened tasks through execute as one BATCH. The batch orchestrator will plan layers, run phases, close rounds, sync trackers, and keep its ordinary `sdd-task --audit-group` lifecycle unchanged. There is no reconcile-only audit flag: execute remains the sole owner of each affected spec group's audit and code-review. Reconcile retains those returned per-group results and checks them at STEP_7; it never dispatches a second review.
